resources.string: Checks at most once a day when opening the app. Automatic downloads are optional; installation always requires system confirmation. No account or music settings are uploaded.
Install the verified update? Your account, music library and settings will be kept. Choose Install or Cancel in the system installer.

Uses a separate Aurora-Music repository. Direct GitHub and accelerated HTTPS routes are tested automatically with fallback. Package, version, size, SHA-256 and signing certificate are verified before installation.
You are using the latest version

The signing certificate does not match this app. Installation was blocked.

Choose Install or Cancel in the TV installation prompt.

Allow this app to install updates in system settings, then try again.

The installer closed or installation was cancelled. The APK is retained; no second download is needed.
